confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of New Zealand price levels; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation is less certain, especially the hostel and 1-star anchors, which vary widely by season and location, and July is winter, which can lower prices outside ski periods. The cocktail and wine anchors were set loosely relative to the beer anchor because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. The FX observation comes from search-result text attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened. A third-party site reported 0.6947 for 16 October 2026, which I did not use because it is not an RBA figure.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against New Zealand's secondary cities and mid-sized Australian regional cities, adjusted to Christchurch's typical café, pub, restaurant and accommodation levels.
